decisions.title: How should the source “Menu” price option be represented in TakeAwayHero?
decisions.sourceText:
#36 Dürüm rulle: BASE 75 kr / Menu 125 kr
#37 Hjemmelavet pitabrød: BASE 75 kr / Menu 125 kr
#39 Hjemmelavet Cafeteriaburger: BASE 75 kr / Menu 130 kr
#40 Baconburger: BASE 69 kr / Menu 125 kr
#41 Cheeseburger: BASE 69 kr / Menu 125 kr
#42 Fiskefilet m. pommes frites: BASE 90 kr / Menu 115 kr
#43 ½ Grillkyling m. pommes frites: BASE 99 kr / Menu 130 kr
decisions.currentInterpretation: Each product keeps BASE as basePrice and a provisional variant/option named “Menu” with derived surcharge. Menu contents are NOT inferred.
decisions.whyNecessary: Source shows a Menu price column but does not document what the Menu includes (drink, fries, etc.). Representation (variant vs combo/ProductChoice) is a product-model decision.

options.label: Keep “Menu” as a priced variant/option per product (current)
options.effect: Imports both prices now; combo contents can be added later. No invented inclusions.

options.label: Treat as combo/ProductChoice — hold creates until contents confirmed
options.effect: Products stay REVIEW until an operator specifies Menu composition; prices preserved as evidence.

options.label: Import BASE only; ignore Menu column for v1
options.effect: Loses Menu upsell prices until a later enrichment pass.

decisions.recommendedRationale: Safest: preserves exact source prices without inventing Menu contents. Semantics can be upgraded once contents are known.

decisions.title: Does “skinke/kebab” represent a customer choice?
decisions.sourceText:
#24 Calzone - Karan
Ingredients: Tomat, ost, salat og
Choices: PRODUCT_CHOICE: skinke/kebab
Source: 24. Calzone -Karan champignon Tomat, ost, 95, skinke/kebab, salat og
decisions.currentInterpretation: Flagged as PRODUCT_CHOICE / unresolved slash-or-eller wording — not silently stored as plain ingredients.
decisions.whyNecessary: Slash/eller/valgfrit wording may mean the guest picks one option, or may be a fixed recipe list. Wrong choice creates wrong POS modifiers.

options.label: Model as ProductChoice (customer selects one)
options.effect: Creates choice options on the product; guest must pick.

options.label: Treat as fixed ingredients (no choice UI)
options.effect: Imports text as ingredients only; no modifier.

options.label: Model as variants (separate sellable sizes/options)
options.effect: Each option becomes a variant with its own price if priced.

decisions.recommendedRationale: Wording indicates an explicit choose-one structure in Danish takeaway menus.

decisions.title: Create or map a destination category for Pasta?
decisions.currentInterpretation: Source category Pasta exists; no destination category match. createCategory remains UNCERTIFIED — dry-run BLOCKs these creates.
decisions.whyNecessary: Cannot assign Pasta products to an existing destination category without inventing a mapping or creating a category.

options.label: Create destination category “Pasta” (when createCategory is certified/authorized)
options.effect: Unblocks Pasta product creates under a new category.

options.label: Map Pasta products into an existing destination category
options.effect: Requires naming which destination category (e.g. Grill / other).

options.label: Defer Pasta migration
options.effect: Leave Pasta products out of the first write batch.

decisions.recommendedRationale: Source has an explicit Pasta heading with three products — a matching destination category is the cleanest model.

decisions.title: Where should #38 Hjemmelavet hvidløgsbrød be filed?
decisions.sourceText: 38. Hjemmelavet hvidløgsbrød Tomat, ost og hvidløg
decisions.currentInterpretation: Not auto-mapped to Durum & Pitabrød solely because it shares an unlabelled source block with #36–37.
decisions.whyNecessary: Garlic bread may belong under Durum & Pitabrød, Grill, sides/tilbehør, or another destination category — source has no heading.

options.label: Assign to Durum & Pitabrød (with #36–37)
options.effect: Groups breads together; may mix garlic bread with wraps.

options.label: Assign to Grill
options.effect: Places with other page-5 mains/sides.

options.label: Assign to another existing category / defer
options.effect: Operator names the category or skips #38 in v1.
